book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Yudas tup qayeeng is xel gyovaxa bei na toung Yesu eivek xel leitata memend
Lek Bouk Wei Yaeing Belet Wei Yis Ma Veil, wei xel mi taxe bei Pasova eno lam paviy.
Xel lumuki leitata yo me xel putoung wei petieing o di yimexe sakwaing wei xel embei nyeis Yesu e mey yo. En xel yaleeng en xomaxoneing.
Woyom Sandang la eivek Yudas, xel mi neil embei Iskariot, xel wei xoumeeng yuw eno ti.
Me Yudas la luk is xel lumuki leitata yo me xel belimbo wei mi yeiteyei xomek vambuing me yimexe sakwaing wei embei neil Yesu teyei me na toung e na eivek xel memend.
Xel wo xeindlala en ingwei xel yei e yo me neil wou Yudas bei tyek xel bong malew wou e.
Om Yudas lewexe lek qayeeng wei xel neil on, de di yimexe sakwaing wei embei bou Yesu eivek xel memend gyeik ingwei moux alis vex ngenong se toundei is e yo.
Betiyeing yayuw menyex wou yaeing
Woyom Bouk Wei Yaeing Belet Wei Yis Ma Veil eno lam, wei xel mi leis sipsip lingheing en yaeing lek bouk wei xel mi wou naleind en Pasova yo.
Om Yesu wong Petele luw Yoan la me neil embei, “Muw ghe na gweiwou mata wei Pasova yo en xey a gha.”
Om luw teling wou e, “Wambei uw a na gheiwou nanghei inya?”
Moxo neil elox, “Ka muw ghe na eivek beyeeng ngandoung eno tambiy ti di qalei memiing eivek deng ti eno tyek nam a tyip wou muw. Eno muw betiy e me ghe na eivek xomek tiwei e la eivek o.
Me muw a neil wou tambiy wei e beeng o bei, ‘Putoung teling wang: Xomek lalei inya wei ambei gha mata wei Pasova is axe xel betiyeing o?’
Moxo tyek talex xomek lalei myasapa wei gheyapu nei wou muw, xel menyex wou dalus woy, om muw ghe gweiwou mata nanghei inyon.”
Luw la me yei lulul la teyei lek ingwei Yesu neil wou luw o. Om luw menyex wou mata wei Pasova yo.
Yesu wong belet aluw wain wou xel betiyeing
Seivma la wou eivek ingwei yaeing o, om Yesu lis e xe sinaleyeiw la dei lek zek.
Me moxo neil wou xel bei, “A laleing vind bei ambei gha mata wei Pasova ne is xam natax dekakom qalei myavanei.
En a neil wou xam, tyek a se nox a gha no qe ka lul tine e bong neing lek eivek Anutu xe tete lalei le.”
Ka Yesu qou mayamya wei wain o ti me wong dange wou Anutu de neil embei, “Xam a qou tine me na num eivek ama senghoing.
En a neil wou xam tyek a se nox a num wain neing no qe ka Anutu xe tete lalei nam bole.”
De moxo qou belet ti, me wong dange wou Anutu me dembu, me wong wou xel betiyeing de neil embei, “Inye a neing wei a wong bei e devind xam. Xam a mi bong ambei nyon en na mi bou naleimim en ay.”
Gyeik xel ya woy eno qou mayamya wain me wong ambei nyon no me neil embei, “Mayamya tine inye qokatu vako, wei a gyand qapyex bei e devind xam o.
Ekom tambiy tiwei embei neil a teyei me na toung ay eivek xel vevek amba memend eno toundei me ya is ay lek zek.
Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek betiwou sakwaing wei Anutu wong wou e yo. Ekom nimaying tyek gyeip wou tambiy tiwei embei neil a teyei me na toung a na eivek xel amba memend o.”
Xel betiyeing ngo qayeeng tiyon eno xel di teling wouma eivek xel venaxow senghoing bei, “Eti tyek bong kwa tiyon?”
Xel betiyeing pyalek ama bei eti tyek bo lei ngandoung
Dekakom xel betiyeing pyalek ama eivek xel venaxow senghoing me neil embei, eti wo lei ngandoung en xel.
Yesu neil wou xel bei, “Xel king wei xel amba eno xel mi wo lei ngandoung me yeiteyei moux alis vex, me xel qou leind ambei nye tambiy wei mi wo nimza wou xel o.
Ekom xam seng bong ambei nyon, qe xelti embei bo lei ngandoung eivek xam senghoing ond e nox yusayang, de xam xe gyovaxa e teyei lek xukxe wei xam o.
En inye eti lei ngandoung, beip inye tambiy wei toundei lek zek, o xukxe wei di duw lul yaeing o? Inyei tambiy tiwei toundei lek zek o. Ekom a toundei eivek xam senghoing nambei xukxe wei di duw o.
Ekom xam wei ghe nale is ay gyeik ingwei axeing lam wou ay yo.
Me a wong tete lalei wou xam, nambei ingwei mang wong wou ay yo.
En kandek xam a mi gwa me na num lek axe zek eivek axe tete lalei me mendei lek xel siaking me ghe pepyawexe xel veleivlei xoumeeng yuw wei Israel o.”
Yesu neil embei Simon tyek dax e vun
Yesu neil embei, “Simon, Simon, Sandang teling en embei daxe xam nambei xel mi seyex wit me wong ninavi veil o.
Ekom Simon, a zeimemang en wang, en wa xe wongeingis e se detei. Me gyeik ingwei wa pekwi me ghe noum eno wa mi byexaxoun limyeiw.”
Ekom Petele neil elox bei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, a xeiwou xow bei tyek nana xeitueing is wang me na mey is wang.”
Yesu lewexe bei, “A neil wou wang, Petele, gyeik ingwei qouklex seng ghei sesa vya boukeing tine eno tyek wang dax a vun luyal me na neimbei wa seng woulek ay.”
Vaxak malew, me vaxak me ngeyeing vevek
Woyom Yesu teling xel, “Gyeik ingwei a wong xam ghe la bandaing veil vaxak malew o vaxak, o vaxalambes, eno xam seng wimexe xow en lulti?” Xel lewexe bei, “Ma.”

De moxo neil wou xel, “Ekom gweimbeeng ne wangwei wa xe vaxak malew, ond wa qou, me vaxak is ambei nyon, de wangwei wa se qou ngeyeing vevek ti, on wang bong vateivek lek teimb ding wei wang o de ghe bou ti.

Xel byex eivek xoulek eno nambei nye, ‘Moux alis vex yei e wo nol ambei tambiy wei nol o.’ A neil wou xam, qayeeng wei xel byex lek ay eivek qapiya eno tyek bo neing lek. Ee, en vati wei xel byex lek ay eno tyek qandi me bo neing lek.”
De xel betiyeing neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wei, ngeyeing vevek yayuw inye.” Moxo neil elox bei, “Inyon woy.”
Yesu zeimema lek lukendu Oliv
Yesu la lukendu Oliv nambei ingwei mi wong lumama yo, me e xe xel betiyeing betiwou e.
Moxo la tyip wou beyeeng wei yo, eno neil wou xel, “Xam a mi zeimemamim, on tyek xam se detei en axeing.”
Moxo dula nayaka nambei ingwei xel mi nex qakous o veil xel, de ev vaxa qatu eivek me zeimema,
“Mang, wangwei wa laleim devind ond wa zeim mayamya tine veil ay. Ekom wa se betiwou a laleing, qe wa betiwou wamaxow laleim.”
Woyom angela wei tyoung gheyapu nei ti lam wou e me byexaxoun e.
Yesu axe myavanei ngandoung, me zeimema nikanzek, me vanei tyip e nambei gyand me teila lek tembuing.
Gyeik ingwei moxo zeimema woy, eno qandi lek me lox me la wou e xe xel betiyeing. Loum yei ekom xel yeip, en xel wo nimaing en xel laleind wo maying.
Yesu teling xel, “Xam ghe weip en vati? Xam qandi lek me zeimemamim, on tyek xam se detei en axeing.”
Xel zeimaxoun Yesu
Ka Yesu nanghei di luk eno xel ngenongakes lam tyip, tambiy tiwei xel neil embei Yudas, xel xoumeeng yuw eno ti qou xel me lam. Moxo la paviy Yesu en embei sesuvexe e,
ekom Yesu teling e, “Yudas, wambei neil Xomaxoneing Neu Moux teyei me na toung e na eivek xel amba memend en sesuvexeing?”
Gyeik ingwei Yesu xe xel betiyeing yei vati wei embei qandi, eno xel neil, “Tambiy Ngandoung, tyek xa nyeis xel en xa xe ngeyeing vevek?”
De xel wei xel venaxow eno ti leis xukxe wei lumuki lukanzek o me qateiv e nenya nge payeiv tip me teila.
Ekom Yesu neil embei, “Woy! Xam seng bong kwa yon no!” De moxo zeim tambiy on nenya me wong e wo nimzalek.

Woyom Yesu neil wou xel lumuki leitata yo, de beyeiv wei xomek vambuing o me xel teivateiv wei lam en e yo bei, “Xam ghe qou ngeyeing vevek me pebumeeng me ghe lam en xam ambei zeim tambiy wei wo vevek, o panaxeing o?
A mindei is xam taxombouk eivek tete lalei wei xomek vambuing o, ek xam seng zeimaxoun ay. Ekom inye xam xe seivma, wei mapetok yeiteyei yo.”
Petele ax Yesu vun
Woyom xel zeimaxoun Yesu me qou e me la eivek lumuki lukanzek o beeng. Petele di betiy xel me di la kwanding ka.
Ekom gyeik xel vev nenyex eivek tete lalei wei xomek tiyon masenghoing me xel xouing toundei wou, eno Petele la dei is xel.
Xukxe vex ti yei ingwei e toundei wou nenyex tumeing o. Vex on yei e kanzek me neil embei, “Tambiy tiyon mindei is e.”
Ekom Petele axvun me neil embei, “Vex, a se woulek e.”
Xel dei nayaka dekakom tambiy nge yei e me neil embei, “Wang on xel wei e yo ti.” Petele neil elox, “Ma, se ay ti!”
Nambei seivma ti la veil om moux nge luk nikanzek me neil embei, “Zonghek ayang tambiy tiyon mendei is e, en inyei e nanghei Galili.”
Petele neil elox bei, “Moux, a se woulek qayeeng tiwei wang di neil on!” Gyeik e ghei di luk eno qouklex wo vya lutika.

Woyom Tambiy Ngandoung pekwi ma me yei Petele bombek. Woyom Petele wounalei en qayeeng wei Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou e yo: “Gweimbeeng boukeing tine qouklex seng ghei sesa vya eno tyek wang dax a vun luyal.”
De Petele la myayaing me la eng ngenong.
Xel napexe Yesu me leis e
Xel moux wei di yeiteyei Yesu eno xel di luk napeing lek e me petapexe e.
Xel tup e ma zeyi nangya qaeing de neil wou e bei, “Wa baluk poropet! Eti petapexe wang?”
Me xel lukyak ngenong lek e is.
Yesu nale wou kanzol mendghalus
De xeiyaing nexla eno teivateiv wei xel xomaxoneing o, is xel lumuki leitata yo, me xel putoung wei petieing wei kanzol o, xel dalus qekuma, me xel qou Yesu me lam eivek xel xe qekueing ama yon.
Me xel neil wou e, “Neil wou xa, wangwei bei inyon wa Kilisi?” Ekom neil elox bei, “Wangwei a neil wou xam, on tyek xam seng bongis ay,
me wangwei a teling wou xam en qayeeng valu, on tyek xam seng zewexe lek.
Ekom gweimbeeng me e mi na bouk loxyus eno Xomaxoneing Neu Moux tyek mendei wou Anutu nikanzek mema payeiv.”
Xel dalus teling wou e, “Inyon wa Anutu Neu Moux?” Moxo neil elox, “Xam venaxow ghe neil bombek. Inye ay.”
Woyom xel neil embei, “Xey a bei se qou pavulek valu en tambiy tine en emaxow mya neil qayeeng tine me xey a ngo woy.”
